articles.title: Taylor Swift's secret detail was almost impossible to spot during her return to the CMA Awards
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift packed her CMA Awards comeback with hidden references, but one special detail stole the show.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift packed her CMA Awards comeback with hidden references, but one special detail stole the show.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift ’s return to the CMA Awards after 13 years was filled with surprises and hidden references, but one small detail caught fans’ attention more than anything else: the presence of Jessie, the iconic cowgirl doll from Toy Story .

During the opening moments of her performance of “I Knew It, I Knew You” —the Toy Story 5 song that reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 — Swift appeared in her dressing room surrounded by career memorabilia, including several outfits from the era of her 2006 self-titled debut album.

Taylor Swift hid an emotional Toy Story detail

Among all the carefully placed details was a very special guest: a Jessie doll sitting on a couch, serving as a direct nod to the character who inspired Swift’s cowgirl-inspired outfit for the night.

The tribute continued throughout the entire performance. Swift wore a sparkling outfit inspired by Jessie , while the stage design recreated elements from the Toy Story universe , including a blue sky filled with clouds, a guitar featuring details reminiscent of Andy’s bedroom wallpaper, and a tree that paid tribute to Tire Swing Hill .

Jessie’s appearance was more than just a decoration. It represented a symbolic connection between Swift’s own journey and the world of Toy Story, highlighting a character known for her courage, loyalty, and fearless personality — qualities Swift brought to the stage during her highly anticipated return to the CMA Awards .

Travis Kelce missed a major night for Taylor Swift

The absence of Travis Kelce also became one of the talking points of the evening. Taylor Swift attended the CMA Awards without her husband by her side, arriving at the event alongside her close friend Brittany Mahomes .

The Kansas City Chiefs tight end is currently navigating a crucial stretch of the NFL season , with the team focused on securing its place in the Playoffs .

Kansas City enters the next phase of the season with a 7-2 record and sitting atop the AFC West , making every game increasingly important in the race for postseason positioning. The Chiefs’ next challenge comes on Sunday, November 22, against the Arizona Cardinals .

articles.title: Bruno Mars shares heartbreaking photo of final embrace with the man who shaped his life
articles.standfirst: The singer is receiving an outpouring of support after sharing a deeply personal moment with his father
articles.summary: The singer is receiving an outpouring of support after sharing a deeply personal moment with his father
articles.body:
B runo Mars has opened up about a painful family loss, giving fans a rare look at a moment he will carry with him for the rest of his life. The singer shared a series of personal memories on Instagram, offering a glimpse into the bond that remained central to his life and career.

The post quickly drew attention from fans, who sent messages of support as they reacted to the emotional images. Among them was a photograph showing Bruno beside his father in a hospital bed, capturing what would become their final embrace.

Bruno Mars remembers the father who taught him everything

The singer revealed that he had the chance to hug his father one last time the previous week . He also reflected on the influence Peter Hernandez had on him, particularly when it came to music, d escribing him as the person who taught him everything he knows.

Bruno also remembered the role his father played in raising their family, which included the singer, his brother and four sisters. He made clear how much Peter meant to him, expressing how deeply he would miss him and sharing a heartfelt message of love in his tribute.

Fans and artists rally around Bruno Mars after emotional tribute

The announcement prompted an outpouring of condolences and support from fans and fellow artists . Many reacted to the Instagram post, especially the photograph of Bruno sharing a final hug with his father, a vulnerable personal moment that offered a glimpse into their goodbye.

Peter Hernandez was 74 years old. He was married to Bruno's mother, Bernadette, who died in 2013. The singer's tribute brought attention not only to the loss of his father but also to the lasting influence he had on the artist and the family he helped raise.

articles.title: Jennifer Lopez finally admits what went wrong after four marriages and divorces
articles.standfirst: The singer is looking back at her romantic history with a different perspective, embracing the lessons that came with every chapter of her life
articles.summary: The singer is looking back at her romantic history with a different perspective, embracing the lessons that came with every chapter of her life
articles.body:
J ennifer Lopez has never hidden how much love has shaped her personal journey. Despite experiencing several public breakups, the actress and singer continues to speak openly about the choices she made, the challenges she faced and the person she has become through those experiences.

At 57, Lopez appears more willing than ever to reflect on her past without allowing it to define her. Her perspective is no longer simply about the relationships that ended, but also about understanding herself and recognizing what each experience taught her.

Jennifer Lopez reflects on the patterns behind her relationships

During a conversation with Drew Barrymore, Lopez acknowledged that she is human and, like everyone else, has tried to make the best decisions she could at every stage of her life. She also made it clear that having multiple divorces was never the goal, but that once those experiences became part of her story, learning from them was what mattered.

Rather than feeling embarrassed by her romantic history, t he superstar has chosen to embrace every version of herself , including the difficult moments and the lessons that came with them. Her willingness to share those experiences has allowed her to approach the subject with honesty instead of shame.

The lessons behind her four marriages

Lopez also opened up about her four marriages during an appearance on the Friends Keep Secrets podcast. She reflected on the emotional impact of her relationships, particularly her separation from Ben Affleck , which was finalized in early 2025 after two years of marriage.

The singer was previously married to Ojani Noa, Cris Judd, Marc Anthony and Affleck. Looking back, she recognized that she had spent years moving from one relationship to another in search of love, without always taking the necessary time to work through her own emotional wounds.

Lopez has also expressed that she can look back knowing she gave her best in each relationship and acted in a way she could be proud of. Although she has not ruled out falling in love again, her experiences have changed how she views romance and what she expects from a future relationship.

articles.title: Who are the finalists for Miss Universe 2026? These are the 116 contestants and the strongest ones for the final night
articles.standfirst: Ahead of the 75th anniversary coronation in San Juan, Puerto Rico, 116 delegates are vying for 30 semifinalist spots
articles.summary: Ahead of the 75th anniversary coronation in San Juan, Puerto Rico, 116 delegates are vying for 30 semifinalist spots
articles.body:
Excitement is reaching a fever pitch in San Juan, Puerto Rico, as 116 delegates from around the globe prepare to compete for the 75th Miss Universe title at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum.

While the official finalists will not be unveiled until the live coronation broadcast on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, hosted by Mario Lopez and Miss Universe 2022 R’Bonney Gabriel , pageant observers, fashion editors, and oddsmakers have already zeroed in on the frontrunners poised to dominate the stage.

Under the competition’s format, all 116 contestants will narrow down to a Top 30 semifinalist group determined through closed-door interviews, the November 21 National Costume Show, the November 22 Preliminary Competition, and global fan voting.

Whoever ultimately succeeds reigning titleholder Fátima Bosch of Mexico will receive the newly unveiled “Radiance of an Eternal Legacy” crown, a 13th-generation headpiece crafted with more than 3,000 diamonds by Venezuelan jeweler George Wittels and Parisian house Maison d’Or.

This milestone edition features historic debuts from Saint Martin and Uganda alongside returning nations such as Jordan (competing for the first time since 1960), Tunisia, and Réunion.

At the same time, the roster reflects significant behind-the-scenes shifts, including a blanket withdrawal of six Southeast Asian franchises, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam, and U.S. travel and visa hurdles that prevented delegates from Angola, Nepal, the Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, Zambia, and Zimbabwe from traveling to Puerto Rico.

Even with those absences, the 2026 field boasts remarkable depth. According to fashion authority Metro.Style and international pageant analysts, several standout candidates lead the race heading into the decisive weekend:

- Bea Millan-Windorski (Philippines): Combining high-fashion storytelling with environmental activism, the 24-year-old champions sea turtle protection and coastal preservation through Project CURMA. Having captured Miss Earth Water in 2024, she brings proven international stage command alongside bespoke Filipino couture by Rajo Laurel.

- Clara Vegas Goetz (Venezuela): Carrying forward a storied pageant lineage as the daughter of Miss Venezuela 1990 Andreína Goetz, the 24-year-old has earned praise for both her humanitarian relief work following June’s earthquakes in Venezuela and her international runway poise, which included opening designer Raúl Peñaranda’s New York Fashion Week show.

- María Alejandra López Pérez (Colombia): At 32, the industrial engineer is one of the most seasoned competitors in San Juan, holding prior international titles such as Reina Hispanoamericana 2013 and speaking fluent Spanish, English, and French.

- Jennifer Barreto (Puerto Rico): Feeding off electric hometown energy, the 27-year-old trained social worker holds graduate degrees in psychology and social work and advocates for survivors of domestic violence and child abuse. Her national costume, “Moriviví: Renacer Borincano,” pays tribute to the island’s resilient native flora.

- Dominga López (Chile): A 25-year-old journalist, actress, and veteran model from Viña del Mar, López pairs sharp communication skills with her anti-bullying campaign, “Atrévete a ser Tú.”

- Garance Authié (France): Selected through a newly organized qualifier after Miss France stepped back from the franchise, the 22-year-old blends London Business School graduate studies with high-fashion runway experience and girls’ education advocacy for Plan International France.

- Georgia Waddington (New Zealand): An entrepreneur running her own social media marketing agency, the 25-year-old swept Swimwear, Evening Wear, and Miss Photogenic honors at home while raising over NZ$9,630 for breast cancer awareness.

- Mia Dio (Cuba) and Melissa Núñez (Dominican Republic): Oddsmakers also rank Cuba’s Mia Dio among the top betting favorites, while psychologists and pageant watchers highlight Melissa Núñez’s impactful substance-abuse recovery advocacy alongside strong European contenders like Spain’s Susana Medina.

Aruba – Elizabeth Johnson (24)

Australia – Caitlin Worthington (29)

Bahamas – Shawndra Henfield (24)

Bangladesh – Samira Khan Mahi (29)

Belarus – Aliya Karotkaya (22)

Belgium – Olga Lombardo (23)

Belize – Caleigh-Rose West (24)

Under the competition’s format, all 116 contestants will narrow down to a Top 30 semifinalist group determined through closed-door interviews, the November 21 National Costume Show, the November 22 Preliminary Competition, and global fan voting.

This milestone edition features historic debuts from Saint Martin and Uganda alongside returning nations such as Jordan (competing for the first time since 1960), Tunisia, and Réunion.

articles.title: This is alkaline hydrolysis, the unusual method of “water cremation” used for Patrick Stewart after his cause of death was confirmed
articles.standfirst: Newly released Los Angeles County Medical Examiner records confirmed that the beloved “Star Trek” and “X-Men” icon died from dementia-related complications and cardiac arrest before undergoing an eco-friendly alternative to traditional flame cremation
articles.summary: Newly released Los Angeles County Medical Examiner records confirmed that the beloved “Star Trek” and “X-Men” icon died from dementia-related complications and cardiac arrest before undergoing an eco-friendly alternative to traditional flame cremation
articles.body:
Nearly three weeks after celebrated British actor Patrick Stewart died at age 86, newly obtained official records have shed light on both his medical battle and the environmentally conscious method chosen for his final disposition.

According to a death certificate from the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner obtained by TMZ, Stewart passed away on October 28 from complications of Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia, with cardiopulmonary arrest, commonly known as cardiac arrest, listed as a contributing factor.

The document also revealed that on November 3, his remains underwent alkaline hydrolysis, an increasingly popular process frequently called “water cremation.”

While traditional cremation relies on intense flames fueled by natural gas, alkaline hydrolysis uses water, gentle heat, and alkaline chemicals to accelerate the natural decomposition process that occurs in soil.

Legalized for human remains in California starting in July 2020, and now permitted in more than half of U.S. states, the procedure places the body inside a sealed stainless-steel vessel filled with a solution of roughly 95 percent water and 5 percent potassium hydroxide or sodium hydroxide.

Over several hours, the warmed liquid circulates through the chamber, breaking down soft tissues into a sterile, neutral liquid effluent composed of amino acids, peptides, salts, and sugars.

Funeral directors and green-burial advocates note that alkaline hydrolysis consumes roughly 90 percent less energy than flame-based cremation and eliminates direct emissions of carbon dioxide, soot, and mercury into the atmosphere.

Once the cycle finishes, the remaining porous calcium phosphate bone fragments are dried and processed into a fine white powder, often yielding 20 to 30 percent more mineral ash than conventional cremation, which is then returned to the family in an urn.

Tributes from family and co-stars honor Patrick Stewart’s enduring legacy

Stewart’s family first shared the news of his death on his official Instagram account last month, revealing that he died peacefully at his Los Angeles residence while in the “loving care” of his wife, Sunny Ozell .

“He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter, and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all,” the statement read.

“We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace,” it continued.

Although his dementia diagnosis had been kept private during his lifetime, Stewart spoke candidly about aging in Hollywood during his final interview before his death.

Speaking with TV Insider in July, the Royal Shakespeare Company veteran acknowledged that older performers face “fewer and fewer available roles,” yet insisted he had no intention of stepping away from the craft.

“I still continue to receive interesting offers, and I love being challenged by new work,” Stewart told TV Insider in July. “I can’t imagine ever officially ‘retiring.’ I’ll always and forever be an actor.”

Across a six-decade career spanning classical theater and blockbuster cinema, Stewart achieved global immortality as Starfleet’s principled Captain Jean-Luc Picard in the “Star Trek” franchise and the telepathic mutant mentor Professor Charles Xavier , also known as Professor X, in the “X-Men” films.

Following his passing, fellow Star Trek icon William Shatner , famous for playing Captain James T. Kirk in the original series, paid tribute to Stewart as “a friend, a colleague, and a magnificent actor.”

“From the stage to the bridge of the Enterprise, he brought intelligence, grace, and a deep sense of humanity to everything he did,” Shatner, 95, wrote on Instagram.

“Captain Picard stood for the best of us, and so did the man who played him. I was filled with affection and admiration for him and his work.”

Marvel Studios echoed those sentiments in a tribute posted on X, thanking Stewart for bringing Professor X to life “with extraordinary grace, intelligence, and humanity, defining the character for generations of fans.”

The studio added, “He was a singular talent, a generous collaborator, and a true gentleman,” capturing the esteem he commanded across the entertainment industry.

Closer to home, Stewart’s loved ones offered quieter, deeply personal farewells. His son, actor Daniel Stewart , posted an uncaptioned throwback photograph showing him giving his father a piggyback ride onstage, a touching gesture that resonated strongly after Stewart’s earlier candid reflections about having a “practically non-existent” relationship with his children resurfaced online.

Two weeks after his passing, Ozell , 47, broke her silence alongside a warm photograph of the pair, sharing that “grief continues to come in waves” while taking comfort in knowing they “left nothing unsaid,” adding, “He knew I loved him, and I know he loved me.”

articles.title: The bus full of women at Leonardo DiCaprio's birthday party sparks a wave of outrage: “He's fat, bloated, scruffy, and disgusting”
articles.standfirst: The actor's star-studded 52nd birthday bash takes an unexpected turn as Kelly tears into his appearance and lifestyle
articles.summary: The actor's star-studded 52nd birthday bash takes an unexpected turn as Kelly tears into his appearance and lifestyle
articles.body:
Leonardo DiCaprio’s 52nd birthday celebration has become the subject of a Hollywood controversy, after footage of glamorous women arriving by bus prompted a furious reaction from broadcaster Megyn Kelly.

The Oscar-winning actor marked his birthday at a private Los Angeles residence on November 14, surrounded by celebrity friends and entertainment industry personalities.

Video published by Page Six showed a white passenger bus unloading women wearing party dresses and heels. Among those reportedly attending was Courtney Boerner , known for appearing on Love Island. DiCaprio’s girlfriend, Italian model Vittoria Ceretti , 28, was also said to be at the gathering.

The guest list reportedly included Al Pacino, Tobey Maguire, Casey Affleck, Orlando Bloom, Cara Delevingne, 50 Cent, Justin Trudeau and Travis Barker, who arrived with his children.

The gathering attracted considerable attention, particularly because of the number of high-profile male celebrities and the glamorous young women arriving separately by bus.

Kelly addressed the images during an episode of The Megyn Kelly Show, displaying footage of the women arriving alongside a photograph of DiCaprio walking on a Hawaiian beach.

“He is a fat, bloated, slovenly, disgusting slob, that’s how Leonardo DiCaprio looks now,” she said.

“If you’re going to be arm candy at Leo’s party, girls, it’s a zero percent body fat situation. Get your s**t together so you can be ogled by the feminists like Justin Trudeau and the disgustingly, slovenly, former stars like Leonard DiCaprio who, he’s still a star, he used to be hot.

“He used to be absolutely beautiful and lusted after by virtually every woman in America. What he’s allowed to happen to himself, I think, is a product of narcissism…”

Kelly’s criticism widens beyond the birthday party

The controversy also drew attention to DiCaprio’s dating history and relationship with Ceretti . The actor has faced scrutiny over dating younger women, although the couple have been publicly linked since 2023.

In an August 2025 interview with Esquire, DiCaprio revealed that he felt considerably younger than his actual age, describing himself as emotionally 35. He also reflected on turning 50, explaining that the milestone had encouraged him to become more honest and avoid wasting time.

“It creates a feeling like you have a desire to just be more honest and not waste your time. I can only imagine how the next few decades are going to progress,” he said.

Another story emerged after Orlando Bloom withdrew from hosting the Child Mind Institute’s gala in New York, citing a bad case of flu.

MSNBC anchor Stephanie Ruhle stepped in and joked on Instagram that his absence might have been caused by “post-DiCaprio-birthday-bash exhaustion,” after reports placed Bloom at the Los Angeles celebration. Bloom is a longtime supporter of the charity, and sources said he was expected to attend next year.

DiCaprio , meanwhile, was photographed with Ceretti at Sotheby’s in New York following the party, where they watched a major contemporary art sale without bidding.

The sale featured 24 postwar and contemporary artworks that collectively fetched approximately $110 million.

articles.body:
S ydney Sweeney has made it clear that sensuality and a love for celebrating different seasons are part of her signature style, and her latest photoshoot for SYRN is proof of that. This time, the 29-year-old actress and model got a head start on Christmas with a look that blends romantic inspiration with a wintery touch.

For the occasion, she wore a white lingerie set featuring a floral lace bra with structured , sheer cups and a low-rise thong adorned with delicate lace details. Sheer thigh-high stockings with lace bands at the top and pointed white heels completed the look.

The set design also played an important role in the photoshoot. The backdrop featured burgundy satin fabrics, white faux fur accents, and other elements that helped recreate a snowy landscape .

However, one detail proved particularly intriguing: Sydney's expression . The actress posed with a serious face and a gaze that seemed to convey sadness, something quite unusual for her, as she is typically seen smiling, looking cheerful, or even striking a playful pose in front of the cameras.

SYRN, the project through which Sydney Sweeney explores lingerie fashion

Beyond her work in front of the camera, this photoshoot also offers another opportunity to showcase SYRN, the lingerie brand Sydney launched in January . articles.title: Hailey Bieber admits she considered suicide because of the hate campaign launched against her by Selena Gomez's fans
articles.standfirst: Speaking candidly with Andrew Ross Sorkin at “The New York Times” DealBook Summit in New York City, the 29-year-old Rhode founder revealed how relentless online harassment and real-world confrontations pushed her to a dark breaking point
articles.summary: Speaking candidly with Andrew Ross Sorkin at “The New York Times” DealBook Summit in New York City, the 29-year-old Rhode founder revealed how relentless online harassment and real-world confrontations pushed her to a dark breaking point
articles.body:
While appearing on stage at The New York Times DealBook Summit in New York City on Wednesday, November 18, Hailey Bieber opened up about the severe psychological toll of being pitted against Selena Gomez for years, admitting that at the height of the backlash, she thought “it would be better if [she] wasn’t here anymore.”

During her conversation with journalist Andrew Ross Sorkin , the 29-year-old model and beauty entrepreneur explained that the hostility went far beyond routine celebrity gossip, spilling out of comment sections and into her daily life.

“I had people telling me to kill myself in the comments every single day. I was going through a time where people were yelling at me in the street,” the Rhode founder shared during her panel at the New York Times’ DealBook Summit in New York on Wednesday.

Even grabbing a routine cup of coffee became a reminder of the public rivalry fueled by social media.

“People were putting tip jars up in Starbucks of me versus this person,” the model recalled, referring to Gomez , who had an on-again, off-again relationship with her husband, Justin Bieber , for nearly a decade.

Unlike celebrities who claim online criticism never bothers them, Bieber acknowledged that she was “too sensitive” to brush off the wave of vitriol, allowing dark thoughts to take hold.

“I had never experienced anything like that before. So the way that people were making me feel was that maybe it would be better if I wasn’t here anymore,” she continued. “Because that’s how intense I felt other people’s feelings were towards me at the time.”

Navigating social media boundaries, motherhood, and a years-long fan feud

Today, Bieber , who welcomed her son, Jack Blues, with Justin in August 2024 and saw her skincare company Rhode acquired by e.l.f. Beauty in a deal valued at up to $1 billion, actively works to “regulate” her screen time. Even so, she admitted it remains “tough to try to limit yourself” when social apps are “so available.”

She also confessed that she continues to “deal with comparison” when scrolling online, adding that she refuses to hide those vulnerabilities so she can eventually guide her own children through the pressures of digital culture.

“I want to be able to have [that conversation] with my kids so that when they’re feeling that way, they can relate to mom,” she shared, “and know that I feel that way too sometimes and we can be in that together.”

Looking back on years of relentless scrutiny, a dynamic that briefly resurfaced even during Wednesday’s summit when Sorkin asked her in a rapid-fire round whether she would buy Gomez’s Rare Beauty, Fenty, Skims, or Kylie Cosmetics, prompting her to choose Skims, Bieber noted she has gradually developed a “resilience” after “so much time of enduring and going through so much intense scrutiny.”

The fixation among sections of the internet dates back to Justin Bieber and Gomez’s high-profile romance, which began in 2010 and spanned numerous breakups and reconciliations, with Justin briefly dating Hailey during some of their off periods.

Their on-and-off chapter closed permanently in 2018 when the “Boyfriend” singer proposed to Hailey just months after splitting from the “Only Murders in the Building” star.

Although Justin and Hailey married in September 2018, and Gomez later moved on, marrying producer Benny Blanco in September 2025, many fans refused to let the past go.

Attempts to project unity never fully quieted the noise. During a September 2022 appearance on “Call Her Daddy,” Hailey insisted it was “all love” between her and the “Hands to Myself” singer, and the two women even posed together for a photograph two months later.

Yet subtle social media digs kept speculation alive, and by June 2025, followers noticed the pair had unfollowed each other on Instagram. Throughout the turbulence, Justin reportedly stood firmly behind his wife.

“Justin trusts Hailey to say what she wants to say and if she gets them into some drama, he’s going to ride or die with her, whether it is about Selena or not,” a source told the Daily Mail in October 2025.

articles.title: Kim Kardashian returns to the Las Vegas Grand Prix, putting speculation about her relationship with Lewis Hamilton to rest
articles.standfirst: They're still together!
articles.summary: They're still together!
articles.body:
Kim Kardashian is back in the Formula 1 spotlight, choosing the Las Vegas Grand Prix to make an appearance during a crucial weekend for Lewis Hamilton . Her presence comes after several races in which the two had not been photographed together, sparking questions about the status of their relationship.

At the Mexican Grand Prix , for example, they were in the same city but were not seen spending time together. The lack of public appearances as a couple fueled speculation that they might be growing apart , although there was never any concrete sign that they were going through a rough patch.

For her Las Vegas appearance, Kim opted for an all-black, leather-effect outfit featuring fitted pants and a matching top .

Lewis Hamilton faces an uphill battle in Las Vegas

While Kim enjoys another weekend in the Formula 1 world, Hamilton has a major challenge ahead of him. The British driver failed to make it into Q3 during Friday's qualifying session, finishing in 12th place . However, Oscar Piastri's penalty allowed him to move up one spot on the grid, meaning the Ferrari driver will start the race from 11th.

The result is another obstacle for the seven-time world champion, who is still chasing his first victory at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. He came close in 2024, finishing second and securing his best result at the circuit so far.

Max Verstappen claimed pole position, followed by George Russell and Lando Norris . The drivers will have 50 laps ahead of them on the street circuit that runs through the famous Strip and passes some of the city's most recognizable landmarks.

articles.title: Did Hermès launch a new Birkin? Lana Del Rey has one inspired by GTA VI
articles.standfirst: The singer arrived at an exclusive party in Miami carrying a bag that looks straight out of Vice City, and it's one that almost no one else will ever get to own.
articles.summary: The singer arrived at an exclusive party in Miami carrying a bag that looks straight out of Vice City, and it's one that almost no one else will ever get to own.
articles.body:
The Grand Theft Auto VI fever has found an unexpected way into the world of luxury fashion. Lana Del Rey was among the guests at a private party in Miami on Thursday night, November 19, and while the event celebrated the highly anticipated video game, one detail of her look quickly stole the spotlight: a Hermès Birkin transformed into a stunning tribute to Vice City .

Inside Lana Del Rey's GTA VI-inspired Birkin

Dubbed the Vice City Birkin, the creation starts with a pink Hermès leather bag, hand-painted with scenes inspired by the world of Grand Theft Auto VI. The artwork is further embellished with thousands of Swarovski crystals, each carefully placed by hand to create a dazzling finish that is impossible to miss .

The design features two different scenes. On the front, palm trees, a neon-colored sunset, and a pink sports car capture the tropical, over-the-top aesthetic that makes Vice City so recognizable. The other side takes a different approach, featuring a yacht sailing across the water with the city's skyline in the background, in a scene that looks as though it could have been lifted straight from the game.

The customization goes beyond simply adding artwork to the bag. Its original leather straps and gussets remain intact, preserving the Birkin's signature structure and functionality . In other words, this isn't a replica inspired by Hermès, but an authentic Birkin that has been given an entirely new identity.

Who created Lana Del Rey's Birkin, and can you buy one?

Behind the transformation are Privé Porter, a company specializing in the resale and customization of luxury handbags, and Moneybags x MB , the art studio founded by Michelle Berk. Together, they brought two worlds rarely seen side by side into one creation: the exclusivity of Hermès and the unmistakable aesthetic of one of the most anticipated video games in recent years.

There is, however, one important distinction: the Vice City Birkin is not an official collaboration with Hermès or Rockstar Games. The French fashion house has not introduced a new design to celebrate GTA VI. Instead, this is an independent customization of an original Birkin.

articles.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in Palm Springs, here's who attended from her family
articles.standfirst: Billy Ray Cyrus, Elizabeth Hurley and Tish Cyrus joined the intimate celebration
articles.summary: Billy Ray Cyrus, Elizabeth Hurley and Tish Cyrus joined the intimate celebration
articles.body:
Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando have married in Palm Springs, California, but the intimate wedding attracted attention for more than just the couple's romantic celebration, with several members of the singer's famous family gathering for the occasion.

The 33-year-old Grammy winner exchanged vows with the 28-year-old drummer on Saturday, November 21, at a private residence, following a relationship spanning approximately five years.

Both Cyrus ' parents attended the ceremony, bringing together relatives whose personal relationships have attracted considerable public attention in recent years.

Her father, country musician Billy Ray Cyrus , was accompanied by his fiancee, actress Elizabeth Hurley , while her mother, Tish Cyrus , attended alongside her husband, actor Dominic Purcell .

Miley's younger sister, Noah Cyrus , was also among the guests, while Hurley's son, Damian Hurley , joined the celebrations and appeared in photographs with the newlyweds.

The gathering was an important personal milestone for Cyrus , who has previously spoken about the stability and happiness she has found with Morando .

Inside the Cyrus-Morando wedding

The ceremony took place beside a swimming pool, where the couple exchanged vows beneath an elaborate arch decorated with white flowers.

Photographs from the private property showed extensive floral arrangements, while aerial images revealed 11 reception tables arranged in a circle for guests.

Flaming Lips frontman Wayne Coyne , a longtime friend and musical collaborator of Cyrus , officiated the ceremony, adding a personal touch to the occasion.

The wedding followed a rehearsal dinner on Friday evening, when Cyrus and Morando were photographed walking together in coordinated black outfits.

Details shared from the pre-wedding gathering revealed a menu featuring filet mignon, sherry cappuccino and hazelnut creme brulee, with the couple's initials and the date printed on the invitations.

The attendance of both Billy Ray and Tish was particularly notable given the family's complicated personal history.

How the romance led to Palm Springs wedding

Cyrus and Morando began dating in 2021 after being introduced through a blind date, an experience the singer later recalled during an interview with British Vogue.

"We got put on a blind date. Well, it was blind for me and not really for him," she explained. "I thought, 'The worst that can happen is I leave.'"

Morando proposed during a trip to Kyoto, Japan, in late 2025, deliberately waiting until the final day to surprise Cyrus .

Speaking to Wonderland magazine, the drummer described the moment he decided to propose while the couple explored the grounds of their hotel.

"She was taking videos and was turned away. That's when I got on one knee and tapped her on the shoulder," he recalled.

Cyrus subsequently discussed their relationship on Good Morning America, explaining how Morando had influenced her personal development.

"Me and Max have been together for four years, and it's very obvious the drastic amount of growth that I've had in those four years … a lot of that is because I have a great partner," she said.

The marriage is Cyrus ' second following her 2018 wedding to actor Liam Hemsworth , with the couple separating the following year.

articles.title: Walt Whitman, American poet: "I have learned that to be with those I like is enough"
articles.standfirst: A reflection on friendship and companionship offers a timeless perspective on finding fulfillment beyond money and success
articles.summary: A reflection on friendship and companionship offers a timeless perspective on finding fulfillment beyond money and success
articles.body:
Happiness is often measured through professional success, financial security or personal achievement, yet American poet Walt Whitman believed that some of life's greatest rewards could be found in something considerably simpler, in spending time with people whose company brings genuine pleasure.

The influential writer, whose work transformed American literature during the 19th century, is widely associated with the observation: "I have learned that to be with those I like is enough."

Behind those words lies a philosophy that challenges the constant pursuit of more, suggesting companionship, affection and shared experiences can provide a sense of fulfillment that material achievements cannot always deliver.

Whitman , born in New York in 1819, became one of America's most celebrated literary figures through his groundbreaking collection Leaves of Grass, first published in 1855.

His poetry frequently explored individuality, freedom, equality and the relationships connecting people across different backgrounds, establishing him as an influential voice in the development of modern American literature.

What did Walt Whitman mean by his quote about happiness?

The quotation is a modernized version of a passage from Whitman 's poem I Sing the Body Electric, which appears in Leaves of Grass.

In the original text, Whitman wrote: "I have perceiv'd that to be with those I like is enough," expressing his appreciation for the simple experience of human companionship.

Whitman was suggesting that meaningful relationships offer their own rewards, without requiring extraordinary experiences, expensive possessions or recognition from others.

His reflections were rooted in an appreciation of ordinary human interaction, including the pleasure of spending an evening among friends or sharing a moment of affection.

Rather than dismissing ambition or personal accomplishment, the passage encourages readers to recognize that fulfillment may already exist within their closest relationships.

The idea remains particularly relevant in a society where success is frequently associated with constant progress, productivity and public recognition.

Why Whitman's words still resonate today

Whitman 's poetry was revolutionary partly because of his determination to celebrate everyday life and the experiences of ordinary people.

At a time when much traditional poetry followed established literary conventions, he embraced free verse and explored subjects ranging from democracy and identity to physical affection and emotional connection.

His reflections on friendship suggest that happiness does not necessarily depend on having a large social circle or an exciting lifestyle.

Instead, the quality of personal relationships can matter more than the number of people someone knows or the activities they pursue together.

The sentiment also encourages a different understanding of contentment, one in which being present with loved ones becomes an achievement in itself rather than something taken for granted.

Whitman died in 1892, but his writing continues to influence discussions about identity, belonging and the meaning of a fulfilling life.

His enduring message is that people don't always need something more to feel complete. Sometimes, the company of those they genuinely care about can be enough.

articles.title: Anthony Hopkins: "Stop having difficult conversations with people who don't want to change"
articles.standfirst: At 88 years old, the actor is once again drawing interest because of a phrase circulating that is attributed to him and that invites reflection on personal relationships, boundaries, and the emotional exhaustion of trying to change those who do not want to do so.
articles.summary: At 88 years old, the actor is once again drawing interest because of a phrase circulating that is attributed to him and that invites reflection on personal relationships, boundaries, and the emotional exhaustion of trying to change those who do not want to do so.
articles.body:
There are conversations that repeat themselves over and over again without getting anywhere. That is the idea conveyed by a phrase circulating on social media attributed to Anthony Hopkins , which invites us to reconsider how much time is worth investing in people who show no willingness to change.

"Stop having difficult conversations with people who don't want to change". The message addresses a common situation: the exhaustion that comes from trying to explain, persuade, or resolve conflicts with someone who is unwilling to listen.

Reflection on personal relationships

The idea behind this phrase is that not every discussion deserves to turn into a battle. Insisting on a conversation can generate more frustration than solutions , especially when the other person has no intention of changing their behavior.

This does not necessarily mean breaking a bond or stopping caring about someone. It can also be interpreted as an invitation to set boundaries , accept that it is not possible to control other people's decisions, and stop taking on a responsibility that does not belong to you.

A personal story marked by overcoming adversity

The reflection finds a point of connection with the actor's personal history, as he has spoken openly about his alcoholism and the moment he decided to ask for help to change his life.

On December 29, 1975, he stopped drinking after living through an experience that made him aware of the seriousness of his problem. Since then, he has maintained his sobriety and has publicly shared his experience to encourage other people to seek support.

In December 2025, Hopkins marked 50 years without drinking alcohol with a message posted on Instagram. In the video, he recalled that decisive moment and encouraged those going through problems with drinking to seek help.

Anthony Hopkins, a career that goes beyond cinema

Two-time Oscar winner Anthony Hopkins has built a career that has made him one of Hollywood's most recognized figures. His trajectory has also been marked by personal experiences that he has chosen to share with the public.

On November 4, 2025, he published his memoir , We Did OK , Kid, in which he revisits different stages of his life, from his childhood in Wales to his professional career and his struggles with alcohol.

His testimony about addiction and the road to recovery helps explain why his messages about life and personal decisions spark interest among his followers. However, the phrase about difficult conversations should be understood as a reflection circulating attributed to the actor, not as a statement whose authorship has been verified.

articles.title: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando tie the knot in private Palm Springs ceremony
articles.standfirst: Surrounded by family and longtime collaborators at Frank Sinatra’s former desert compound, the 33-year-old pop star made her marriage official on Saturday before sharing intimate moments online
articles.summary: Surrounded by family and longtime collaborators at Frank Sinatra’s former desert compound, the 33-year-old pop star made her marriage official on Saturday before sharing intimate moments online
articles.body:
Beneath the California desert sky on Saturday evening, November 21, Miley Cyrus and musician Maxx Morando made their longtime partnership official at an outdoor wedding held on a historic Palm Springs estate once owned by Frank Sinatra .

Flaming Lips frontman Wayne Coyne , a trusted friend and frequent musical collaborator of the 33-year-old singer , presided over the vows as a tightly curated circle of loved ones gathered poolside.

Among those looking on were Cyrus’s parents, Tish Cyrus and Billy Ray Cyrus , who attended alongside his partner, Elizabeth Hurley , as well as Jesse Light, Katy Coyne, Jacob Bix, Olivia Rudensky, Shawn Everett, Dr. Amen, Vijat, and songwriter Michael Pollack .

By Sunday morning, Cyrus offered her Instagram followers an intimate window into the celebration, pairing a minimalist caption with a series of candid portraits. “M + M,” she wrote. “11.21.26.”

Rather than staging overly formal poses, the newlyweds stood affectionately beside their dog in front of a photo backdrop before closing the carousel with the ceremony’s defining frame: Cyrus walking down the aisle and sharing a kiss with the 28-year-old Liily drummer while guests erupted in applause and Tish Cyrus clapped happily from the sidelines.

How a 2021 blind date evolved into an equal partnership

Saturday’s vows capped a five-year romance that began with an introduction orchestrated by mutual friends, leading to the couple’s first public outing at Los Angeles’s Gucci Love Parade fashion show in November 2021.

Over the years that followed, their personal chemistry spilled effortlessly into the recording studio, where Morando contributed to Cyrus’s Grammy-winning era on Endless Summer Vacation and her follow-up album Something Beautiful, before he proposed during a trip to Kyoto, Japan, in late 2025.

Looking back on their earliest days together in a June 2023 British Vogue profile, Cyrus laughed about how uneven the element of surprise had been.

“We got put on a blind date. Well, it was blind for me and not really for him,” she told British Vogue in an interview published in June 2023.

“I thought, ‘The worst that can happen is I leave.’” In that same conversation, she casually remarked, “I call that ‘boyfriend sexy ringtone,’” capturing the laid-back dynamic that quickly took root between them.

Even with years of trust behind them, Cyrus confessed during a September Apple Music sit-down with Zane Lowe that pre-wedding jitters briefly triggered fears of losing her infatuation after walking down the aisle.

“We've been together six years, and I've never gotten the ick. All of a sudden I got in my head, I was like, ‘Oh my God, we're about to get married. What if I get the ick?’” Cyrus said.

When she voiced that worry directly to Morando, his blunt reply immediately broke the tension: “I asked him, ‘What happens if you get the ick once you’re married?’ He’s like, ‘You deal with it and you move on and you don't be a baby. The ick is for when you're in fifth grade.’”

Not long afterward, Morando briefly tested his own rule, prompting Cyrus to joke, “He did something that ‘icked’ me for a minute. I was like, ‘Don't ever do that again. It gave me the ick,’” She was equally candid about her own shortcomings, admitting she gets “really stinky about it” whenever she is not calling the shots and adding, “He said, ‘When you're a brat,’ which is so true. I'm so icky when I'm a brat.”

For Cyrus , who previously spent roughly a decade in an on-and-off relationship with actor Liam Hemsworth, including an eight-month marriage that ended with their August 2019 separation, stepping back from sole control at home has proved transformative.

“What I also love is I'm not totally the boss in our house,” Cyrus went on. “It's like a sense of relief that I can actually soften into, because he’s going to watch this and be like, ‘You're not the boss. We're both the boss.’” That shared balance underpins the outlook she is bringing into married life: “Marriage doesn't need to be a prison. It can actually be a playground.”

articles.title: The Weeknd finds his $50 million mansion inside GTA VI
articles.standfirst: The singer is featured on the video game's soundtrack, but he stumbled upon a much more personal surprise while exploring Vice City.
articles.summary: The singer is featured on the video game's soundtrack, but he stumbled upon a much more personal surprise while exploring Vice City.
articles.body:
Grand Theft Auto VI has managed to spark curiosity even among those who are already part of its universe . Just ask The Weeknd, who, alongside contributing to the game's soundtrack with My Only Vice, an unreleased track he performs with French duo Justice, and Wanderlust, from his 2013 album Kiss Land, discovered a much more personal surprise while exploring Vice City .

As he made his way through the map, the singer came across a mansion that bears a striking resemblance to one of his properties in Miami, Florida.

The discovery caught fans' attention, and now they are eager to see what the real-life residence looks like.

What is the property like?

The mansion is located in Gables Estates, an exclusive gated community in Coral Gables, South Florida. The Weeknd purchased it in October 2025 for approximately $50 million, setting a residential sales record in the city .

Built on a 1.24-acre, V-shaped peninsula, the property is surrounded by water on three sides and boasts 574 feet of Biscayne Bay frontage . Spanning approximately 19,000 square feet, it features eight bedrooms, nine full bathrooms and two half-baths.

Among its standout outdoor features are a 62-foot infinity pool, a jacuzzi, an outdoor kitchen and expansive terraces overlooking the water. The property also has a private 140-foot dock capable of accommodating a yacht up to 200 feet long.

Inside, the mansion features a private movie theater, gym, wine cellar and bar, completing a residence designed to make the most of its luxurious setting and stunning bay views.

articles.title: YouTuber IShowSpeed accelerates faster than Usain Bolt and runs the 100 meters in 10.35: "I will go to the Olympic Games"
articles.standfirst: IShowSpeed has been training with Ato Boldon for over a year and has impressed Usain Bolt with his acceleration and speed
articles.summary: IShowSpeed has been training with Ato Boldon for over a year and has impressed Usain Bolt with his acceleration and speed
articles.body:
American streamer, YouTuber, and content creator IShowSpeed (21) clocks an impressive 10.352 seconds in the 100 meters, leaving Usain Bolt impressed.

In the episode titled "I Raced Usain Bolt" (I races Usain Bolt!) , the second of the Speed Goes Pro season, the streamer who had been training for months managed to run the 100 meters in 10.352 seconds on his second attempt.

In 2028, without a doubt, I will be competing in the Olympic Games

The absolute Spanish records for the 100 meters recognized by the Royal Spanish Athletics Federation (RFEA) are 10.06 seconds in the men's category and 11.06 seconds in the women's category .

The women’s 100-meter world record is 10.49 seconds , achieved by American athlete Florence Griffith-Joyner on July 16, 1988.

Ato Boldon: "I thought IShowSpeed would last two weeks... We've already been working together for over a year"

Ato Boldon , a four-time Olympic medalist, has been coaching Speed since September 2025 and has praised his commitment: "I thought he'd last two weeks, but the truth is he came to train, kept coming, arrives on time and works very hard... We've been working together for more than a year now; his body is starting to change and he already has the right look."

IShowSpeed accelerated more in the first 15 meters than Usain Bolt

Although it is not an official competition time and is 0.772 seconds behind Bolt's world record (9.58) , the graphs showed that his acceleration over the first 15 meters surpassed the Jamaican's initial speed .

The eight-time Olympic champion was surprised by the speed reached by IShowSpeed, a YouTuber with no background in athletics .

Usain Bolt, who offered IShowSpeed several pieces of advice, believes the famous streamer has the potential to become a professional sprinter .

"I think so," Bolt said when Speed asked him if he could become a professional.

Speed made his objective clear: "In 2028, without a doubt, I will be competing in the Olympic Games" .

articles.title: Jacques Bossuet, writer: “Politics is an act of balance between the people who want to get in and those who do not want to get out”
articles.standfirst: A phrase that would fit perfectly with current Spanish politics
articles.summary: A phrase that would fit perfectly with current Spanish politics
articles.body:
Six days before Spaniards go to the polls in the snap general election on November 29 (29N), many are recalling a famous phrase that would fit the current reality perfectly: “Politics is an act of balance between the people who want to get in and those who do not want to leave”.

It is usually attributed to the French clergyman and writer Jacques-Bénigne Bossuet (1627-1704), but there is no evidence that it belongs to him, since it does not appear as such in any of his works.

Historians point out that Bossuet was the great theorist of monarchical absolutism and divine right at the court of Louis XIV, so the phrase fits his character. To explain it, it means that on the side of those who “do not want to leave” stands the President of the Government, Pedro Sánchez, at La Moncloa since 2018. Alongside the PSOE, the new Broad Front, led by Ada Colau, and Podemos, with Irene Montero, are fighting to become that second political force on the left.

Opposite them, the bloc of “those who want to come in” is led by Alberto Núñez Feijóo’s PP and Vox with Santiago Abascal. If he did say such a phrase, Bossuet would have said it in the last quarter of the 17th century, approximately between 1670 and 1704, when he was tutor to the Dauphin of France, the son of Louis XIV, and bishop of Meaux.

Other famous quotes by Jacques Bossuet

“In Egypt, libraries were called the treasure of remedies for the soul. Indeed, in them one was cured of ignorance, the most dangerous of diseases and the origin of all the others.”

“The most dangerous of all weaknesses is the fear of appearing weak.”

“The possession of wealth has invisible ties where the heart easily becomes entangled.”

“Human life resembles a road whose end is a horrifying precipice; we are warned of this from our very first steps; but the decree has already been pronounced: we must always move forward, unable to turn back”.

articles.title: “Bruce Willis is still the hero we all know”: Tallulah Willis speaks out after deleting a ‘too intimate’ photo with her father
articles.standfirst: Following mixed reactions online to a candid porch-swing snapshot with the retired “Die Hard” icon, his 32-year-old daughter removed the post and promised greater discretion while reaffirming her family’s fierce love and respect
articles.summary: Following mixed reactions online to a candid porch-swing snapshot with the retired “Die Hard” icon, his 32-year-old daughter removed the post and promised greater discretion while reaffirming her family’s fierce love and respect
articles.body:
Navigating life in the public eye while caring for a loved one with dementia carries a delicate balance between raising awareness and protecting personal dignity.

Over the weekend, Tallulah Willis experienced that tension firsthand after posting, and subsequently deleting, a candid Instagram photograph with her father, retired Hollywood star Bruce Willis .

The original snapshot, shared on Saturday, showed the 32-year-old holding hands with the 71-year-old “Die Hard” actor while seated together on a porch swing during a family visit.

While many admirers flooded the comments with heartfelt support, the rare glimpse of Willis amid his ongoing health battle also sparked debate online over privacy and consent, prompting Tallulah to remove the image and address her followers directly on Sunday, November 22.

Posting her reflection over a black-and-white throwback photograph of her father kissing her on the cheek as a child, Tallulah explained that the deleted image had been taken during a quiet afternoon spent watching a video of Frankie Valli performing.

Although she still cherished the “super sweet” memory, she admitted she had acted in the heat of the moment without considering how vulnerable the image might appear to outsiders.

“I was very excited by the sweetness of the moment that I didn't think farther ahead that this was possibly too intimate a photo to show,” Tallulah wrote.

“I acknowledge that and vow to do better. I know you all love him. I love him. My family loves him. And he's still always the absolute hero we know him to be.”

How the Willis family balances public advocacy with protecting Bruce’s dignity

Followers quickly rallied around Tallulah in the comments section, urging her not to be hard on herself and reminding her that she owes no one an apology for cherishing everyday moments with her dad.

Since the Willis family first announced in March 2022 that Bruce was stepping away from his four-decade acting career due to aphasia, before sharing a more specific diagnosis of frontotemporal dementia (FTD) in early 2023, his blended family has been remarkably open about the realities of the progressive neurological condition.

Together with her mother, Demi Moore , sisters Rumer and Scout, and Bruce’s wife, Emma Heming Willis , who shares daughters Mabel and Evelyn with the actor, Tallulah has regularly used her platform to destigmatize FTD and highlight the small moments of joy that remain.

Earlier this year, Bruce even made a rare, celebratory appearance at Tallulah’s August wedding to musician Justin Acee in Sun Valley, Idaho.

At the same time, Tallulah has never hesitated to push back aggressively whenever tabloids or anonymous insiders cross the line into sensationalism.

Earlier this month, she publicly blasted a published report that quoted an unnamed source claiming the beloved action star was behaving like a child.

“So the 'friend,' 'family member,' or source who shared that he 'acts like a baby now?' How is that acceptable? Who are you?” she wrote at the time.

Sunday’s candid apology underscored that same protective instinct. Even as fans around the world remain eager for updates on one of cinema’s most enduring leading men, Tallulah made clear that safeguarding her father’s legacy and humanity will always come before social media engagement.

articles.title: She’s defrosted! Mariah Carey performs “All I Want for Christmas Is You” in Rio de Janeiro
articles.standfirst: Christmas is officially getting closer, and the Queen of Christmas is already making sure nobody forgets it
articles.summary: Christmas is officially getting closer, and the Queen of Christmas is already making sure nobody forgets it
articles.body:
Mariah Carey is back on the road with her annual holiday celebration, bringing her signature festive energy to audiences in Braz il. The singer kicked off this year's Christmas Time concert series in São Paulo before heading to Rio de Janeiro for another highly anticipated performance .

Mariah Carey brings her Christmas magic to Brazil

The 57-year-old superstar took the stage at Farmasi Arena in Rio de Janeiro on November 21, where her holiday catalog was among the highlights of the show. Her set included some of the biggest hits of her career, giving Brazilian fans the opportunity to celebrate the season with one of pop music's most recognizable voices.

Naturally, her 1994 classic “ All I Want for Christmas Is You” was part of the festive celebration. The song has already started making its annual comeback on the charts , recently returning to the Billboard Hot 100's top 20 at No. 18.

Mariah Carey addresses concerns during her Rio concert

However, her appearance in Brazil also came amid growing conversations about her health and stage presence. Videos from her November 17 performance in São Paulo circulated online, with viewers expressing concern about her movements during a rendition of “Fantasy” and the assistance she received from her backup dancers.

The discussion followed Carey to Rio, where she appeared to address the speculation while speaking to the audience . She made it clear that fans should be cautious about believing everything circulating online, adding a warning that she did not appreciate the rumors . The Independent reported on her response following the concert.

Carey is currently continuing her Christmas Time concert series, with upcoming stops in Birmingham, London, Manchester, Malta and Abu Dhabi. The tour is scheduled to run through December 12, keeping the singer on the road throughout the holiday season.

Meanwhile, her C hristmas anthem is once again finding its way onto the charts as the festive period approaches . More than three decades after its release, “All I Want for Christmas Is You” remains one of the defining songs of the season, and Mariah Carey is ready to make sure the tradition continues.

articles.title: What caused Gabriel Iglesias’ health scare that left him asking for oxygen onstage?
articles.standfirst: The comedian tried to push through the night, but his final moments onstage quickly turned into a worrying situation for everyone in attendance
articles.summary: The comedian tried to push through the night, but his final moments onstage quickly turned into a worrying situation for everyone in attendance
articles.body:
G abriel Iglesias gave fans an unexpected scare during his latest comedy appearance in Raleigh, North Carolina, when his performance took an alarming turn. The comedian had to be escorted offstage after struggling to continue his set , prompting concern among audience members who watched the situation unfold.

The incident happened at the Lenovo Center, where Iglesias was scheduled to perform an hour-long show. Fellow comedian Martin Moreno introduced him to the crowd, mentioning beforehand that Iglesias was not feeling particularly well.

Gabriel Iglesias' condition worsened toward the end of the show

Despite feeling unwell, Iglesias made his way onto the stage and continued entertaining the audience. However, with only a few minutes remaining, he sat on a stool before standing up and leaning forward, appearing unsteady as he struggled to remain on his feet.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney gives fans another treat before Christmas by braving the cold in nothing but a sheer bra
articles.standfirst: Sydney flaunts her latest collection in a sizzling Christmas shoot that's sending fans into a frenzy
articles.summary: Sydney flaunts her latest collection in a sizzling Christmas shoot that's sending fans into a frenzy
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney has brought a wintry setting and a bold look to Syrn’s latest holiday campaign, giving followers another glimpse of the lingerie label she launched earlier this year.

The actress appears in a series of snowy promotional images wearing a white, sheer lace halter bra and matching low-rise underwear from the brand’s Seductress collection. Thigh-high stockings, pale heels and dramatic red fabric trimmed with white fur complete the look.

Her retro-inspired hair and red lipstick add a touch of color to the otherwise icy scene.

Sweeney teased the release with the caption, “A little frost, a lot of Seductress,” while Syrn described the pictures as the first flurry of the collection’s season.

The campaign's contrast between winter scenery and revealing lingerie has quickly caught attention online, with fans filling the comments with compliments about the actor's appearance.

The new photographs follow several holiday-themed previews from Syrn. Earlier promotional material drew on familiar Christmas-film imagery, including references to Home Alone and other seasonal favourites, as the company rolled out a series of distinct moods for its holiday shop.

The Seductress range is one part of a wider offering that also includes Comfy, Playful and Romantic styles. The collection features bras, underwear and coordinated pieces designed around different aesthetics, with Sweeney closely involved in shaping the brand's identity.

Syrn’s holiday push arrives during a busy year

Sweeney hasn't been the only face of the label's marketing, but she's returned to the camera for this latest winter-themed instalment.

The business appears to be gaining momentum, with a report citing an industry source saying Syrn's third-quarter sales doubled compared with the previous quarter and were more than three times its June sales.

The figures suggest the brand's early campaigns have helped build interest, giving Sweeney another reason to celebrate as she continues balancing her business ventures with Hollywood commitments.

Away from lingerie, Sweeney has a packed slate of screen projects. She's returning as Millie in The Housemaid's Secret, the next instalment based on Freida McFadden's bestselling thriller series. Michele Morrone is also expected to return, while Kirsten Dunst is joining the cast. Lionsgate has scheduled the sequel for December 17, 2027.

The actress has also been linked to speculation surrounding the next James Bond film, following Robert Pattinson's announcement as the new 007. Although Sweeney has been mentioned as a possible Bond girl, no official casting announcement has confirmed her involvement.

Another exciting project on her schedule is Hollow, a gothic thriller inspired by Washington Irving's The Legend of Sleepy Hollow. Sweeney is set to produce and star in the film, which retells the familiar story through the perspective of Katrina Van Tassel.

With several major projects ahead and Syrn continuing its seasonal rollout, Sweeney's latest shoot gives the lingerie brand another high-profile moment just as the Christmas shopping season gathers pace.

articles.title: Miley Cyrus’ viral wedding guest sparks a family response after her yellow-dress mishap: Who is Belgica Vargas?
articles.standfirst: One unexpected detail managed to stand out during a celebration that had otherwise brought together some of the couple’s closest friends and family members
articles.summary: One unexpected detail managed to stand out during a celebration that had otherwise brought together some of the couple’s closest friends and family members
articles.body:
M iley Cyrus and Maxx Morando tied the knot in an intimate ceremony in Palm Springs , California, on November 21. While the newlyweds were supposed to be the center of attention, photographs from the event sparked a different conversation online, with one guest becoming an unexpected talking point.

Belgica Vargas finds herself at the center of the wedding controversy

The woman in question is Belgica Vargas , a graphic designer married to music producer Shawn Everett, a close friend and longtime collaborator of Cyrus . Everett worked on the singer’s 2025 album, Something Beautiful , and attended the wedding alongside his wife.

The problem was her outfit. While the couple had requested an all-black dress code, Vargas arrived wearing a mustard-yellow dress with noticeable puffed details on the shoulders. Im ages of the ceremony quickly circulated , and the contrast between her look and the rest of the guests made her stand out in several wedding photographs.

Her sister explains the mix-up as criticism continues

The outfit and Vargas herself have faced considerable criticism online, with many questioning how such an important detail could have been overlooked . For several fashion commentators, the situation represented a major breach of wedding etiquette and a lack of consideration for the bride and groom. There were also plenty of ways the situation could have been handled differently: had Vargas noticed the requested dress code upon arriving, she could have changed outfits out of respect for the couple rather than allowing the mismatch to become a defining part of the celebration.

According to her explanation, Belgica had received the invitation two months earlier, but the dress code detail had slipped past the couple. Grecia also suggested that her brother-in-law, who is known for wearing more unconventional outfits, had not properly communicated that requirement to his wife . She acknowledged that her sister should have checked the invitation more carefully, while adding that the family was taking the unexpected attention with some humor.

Despite the online reaction, the bride reportedly handled the situation with kindness. Grecia told People that Belgica initially felt extremely embarrassed when she realized her mistake, but no one at the celebration made her feel uncomfortable . When Miley approached her, she greeted her warmly, hugged her and complimented her appearance , helping the guest feel more at ease during the reception.

articles.title: Miss Universe 2026 LIVE. Top 30, predictions, and more about the beauty pageant
articles.summary: Months of preparation will culminate in one of the biggest nights in the world of beauty pageants as Miss Universe 2026 celebrates its 75th edition wi
articles.body:
Get every live update from the 2026 Miss Universe final night : Where to Watch, starting time, and predictions. We have all the details on tonight's international pageant at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

What time is Miss Universe 2026?

The Miss Universe 2026 final night will take place this Tuesday, November 24, 2026 . This is the definitive night for the top 30 contestants and is scheduled for:

Where to watch live Miss Universe 2026?

Fans of the Miss Universe pageant will be able to watch the final night live on Telemundo in Spanish, with English subtitles; and REELZ in English, with streaming on Peacock, REELZ+, and YouTube via REELZ All Access.

Months of preparation will culminate in one of the biggest nights in the world of beauty pageants as Miss Universe 2026 celebrates its 75th edition with a spectacular grand finale in San Juan, Puerto Rico .

The Jose Miguel Agrelot Coliseum will host the highly anticipated ceremony on Tuesday, November 24 , where reigning Miss Universe Fatima Bosch of Mexico will officially end her reign and crown her successor in front of millions of viewers around the world.

This year's competition brings together 116 contestants from different countries and territories , all hoping to become the next woman to wear the prestigious Miss Universe crown. The 2026 edition also features historic participation, with debutants Saint Martin and Uganda joining the competition, while several nations return to the international stage after previous absences.

However, as the final night approaches, the race for the crown has taken an unexpected turn. The Philippines has emerged as the leading favorite in a new independent ranking that reshuffled several of the top contenders just days before the winner is announced.

According to Major Beauty Pageants , the Philippines overtook Colombia in its latest cumulative Top 30 ranking , based on nearly two weeks of evaluations that considered factors such as elegance, stage presence, styling, consistency and participation in official activities.

The Philippines, represented by Bea Millan-Windorski , moved into first place, while Colombia dropped to second. Venezuela climbed to third, New Zealand moved into fourth and host country Puerto Rico fell to fifth despite remaining one of the most talked-about candidates due to the support of the home crowd.

Other notable movements included the Netherlands , which jumped seven positions, and Costa Rica , which improved six spots during the evaluation period.

The changes have added even more excitement ahead of the final competition, especially after the preliminary events, including interviews, national costume presentations and the preliminary competition, gave fans their first look at the strongest candidates for the crown.

Who are the favorites for Miss Universe 2026?

While independent rankings have generated conversation among fans, they do not determine the official results. The final decision will come from the Miss Universe judges after evaluating the contestants during the different stages of the competition.

The Philippines, Colombia, Venezuela, New Zealand and Puerto Rico are considered among the strongest contenders heading into the final night, although other candidates could emerge as surprises once the competition begins.

A separate ranking from Missosology offered a different perspective, placing Puerto Rico first , followed by New Zealand and the Philippines, highlighting how unpredictable the race remains before the official coronation.

Social media adds another layer to the competition

Beyond the runway and judging criteria, social media has become another major topic surrounding Miss Universe 2026. Several contestants have gained enormous international attention through platforms such as Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

A social media popularity ranking places Bangladesh's Samira Mahi at the top, followed by representatives from Cuba and Myanmar's May Grace Parry . Spain's Susana Medina , Ecuador's Dalia Bucaram , Nicaragua's Jasmine Blandford and Venezuela's Clara Vegas Goetz also rank among the most followed contestants.

However, online popularity does not guarantee success on stage. Contestants will ultimately be judged on their confidence, communication skills, presence and overall performance during the final rounds.

With the crown ready to be passed to a new winner, the competition remains wide open. The Philippines currently leads one major prediction, but Colombia, Venezuela, New Zealand and Puerto Rico remain serious contenders for the title of Miss Universe 2026 .

articles.title: Eiza González nearly suffers a panic attack during a wild lap around the Las Vegas F1 track
articles.standfirst: What started as an exciting opportunity quickly turned into an experience the Mexican actress might think twice about repeating.
articles.summary: What started as an exciting opportunity quickly turned into an experience the Mexican actress might think twice about repeating.
articles.body:
E iza González was among the celebrities who attended the Las Vegas Grand Prix over the weekend, joining the high-profile crowd gathered for one of Formula 1's most glamorous events. The actress shared several moments from her visit with her followers, giving them a glimpse of her experience beyond the race itself.

However, one particular activity proved far more intense than she had anticipated. González decided to take part in an adrenaline-filled experience that put her nerves to the test, and her social media followers got to witness every second of her reaction.

Eiza González struggles to keep her nerves under control

The Hollywood actress climbed into a high-speed car for a lap around the Las Vegas circuit. She initially appeared excited about the opportunity, but her mood changed dramatically once the driver started accelerating.

In videos shared on Instagram, González could be heard screaming and repeatedly asking the driver to slow down and stop . Her nervous reaction became even more pronounced as the vehicle continued speeding around the track, making it clear that the experience was overwhelming for her.

The actress admits she has never been so frightened

Things became even more intimidating when the driver informed her that they had not yet reached their maximum speed. The news left González visibly distressed, as she reacted with disbelief at the idea that the ride could become even faster. Throughout the journey, the actress continued expressing her fear while the driver attempted to reassure her. At one point, she also asked how much longer they would have to continue before finally reaching the end of the lap

Once the car stopped, González was able to laugh about what had happened, although she admitted the experience had left her genuinely shaken . She described it as one of the scariest moments she had ever experienced and suggested that getting back into a car for another high-speed lap was not something she planned to do anytime soon . THe actress documented the entire adventure through Instagram videos, allowing fans to see a much more vulnerable side of her during her Las Vegas Grand Prix appearance.

articles.title: Dua Lipa's daring new looks give off District 12 vibes and send Hunger Games fans wild
articles.standfirst: Is she part of the franchise now?
articles.summary: Is she part of the franchise now?
articles.body:
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping hit theaters across the United States on November 20 , bringing another chapter of Suzanne Collins' saga to the big screen and exploring a different moment in the history of the Hunger Games. Its release gave fans another chance to return to the world of Panem.

And just as the franchise is back in the spotlight, Dua Lipa unexpectedly found herself joining the conversation. The singer shared a new set of photos on Instagram on November 21, and some of her outfits had fans spotting more than a few similarities to Katniss Everdeen and District 12.

Which look first sparked the comparisons? A figure-hugging dress that combined burgundy and black tones, featuring a sweetheart neckline and side cutouts that revealed glimpses of her skin . The design had the daring touch that often defines the artist's fashion choices, but there was something else that made the movie reference even more convincing.

The setting seemed to come straight out of that universe, too. The trees, greenery, and chilly atmosphere surrounding the photos brought to mind the landscapes of District 12, where Katniss grew up long before becoming the face of the rebellion.

And if that outfit had already got fans' imaginations running wild, another photo from the post made the connection even stronger. This time, Dua opted for an icy blue satin camisole with black floral lace, a plunging neckline, and an open back. Thin straps and a diamond-shaped cutout at the center of the bodice completed the design, which she paired with denim jeans.

The setting once again featured the natural surroundings and cool-weather feel that accompany much of The Hunger Games aesthetic. Between the singer's fashion choices and the landscapes she picked for her photos, her followers found plenty of reasons to take a trip back to Panem.
