articles.summary: The couple have increasingly appeared alongside each other at major public events
articles.body:
B rad Pitt appears to have found lasting happiness again following his highly publicized split from Angelina Jolie. The Oscar-winning actor has been dating Ines de Ramon, the ex-wife of The Vampire Diaries star Paul Wesley, since 2022. After keeping their romance largely out of the spotlight for years, the couple made another major public statement by walking the red carpet together at Pitt’s latest film premiere a couple of days ago .

Brad Pitt’s love life has remained a subject of fascination ever since his marriage to Angelina Jolie ended, but the Hollywood star appears to have entered a new chapter with someone who has largely managed to stay away from the celebrity spotlight. The Once Upon a Time in Hollywood actor has been romantically linked to Ines de Ramon, a Swiss jewelry executive and the former wife of actor Paul Wesley , since November 2022.

The couple have been together for approximately four years, have reportedly lived together since early 2024 and have increasingly appeared alongside each other at major public events. Their latest appearance came on November 16th, when Pitt and de Ramon walked the red carpet hand-in-hand at the Los Angeles premiere of his Netflix film The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth . It was a particularly notable moment for a couple who have traditionally preferred to keep their relationship private.

Although Pitt has rarely discussed his romantic life publicly since his separation from Jolie in 2016, his relationship with de Ramon has become one of Hollywood’s most closely followed romances. So, who is the woman who captured Pitt’s attention , what is her connection to another famous Hollywood actor, and how did their relationship develop?

Who is Ines de Ramon, Brad Pitt’s girlfriend?

Unlike Pitt, whose personal life has been followed by the entertainment media for decades, de Ramon has maintained a relatively low public profile. Born in Switzerland, she is a jewelry industry professional who has built her career independently of her connections to Hollywood celebrities.

According to her professional LinkedIn profile, de Ramon graduated from the University of Geneva with a bachelor’s degree in business administration. She also speaks five languages: French, English and Spanish at bilingual or native proficiency levels, as well as German and Italian at professional working proficiency.

Before joining the Los Angeles-based jewelry brand Anita Ko, she spent approximately four years working in the retail department of Swiss jewelry company de GRISOGONO . At Anita Ko, she serves as vice president, a position that places her in the luxury jewelry business rather than the entertainment industry.

Her Instagram account, which has more than 114,000 followers, occasionally offers glimpses of her travels, social engagements and professional activities. However, she generally avoids sharing extensive details about her private life. That discretion has remained a defining characteristic of her relationship with Pitt.

Ines de Ramon was previously married to Paul Wesley

One of the most interesting aspects of de Ramon’s background is her previous marriage to another Hollywood actor. She was married to Paul Wesley, best known for playing Stefan Salvatore on the popular television series The Vampire Diaries.

The couple reportedly married in 2019, although they kept much of their relationship away from public attention. In September 2022, representatives for Wesley and de Ramon confirmed that they had separated after three years of marriage. The separation reportedly occurred several months earlier, and the pair subsequently moved toward ending their marriage.

Their divorce proceedings included a request from de Ramon to restore her former name, with the couple reportedly agreeing that neither would receive spousal support. Their separation became public just two months before d e Ramon was photographed with Pitt at a Bono concert in Los Angeles.

Although their respective relationships with Pitt and Wesley have attracted considerable attention, there is no indication that the two Hollywood actors’ personal lives are connected beyond their shared relationship with de Ramon.

How Brad Pitt and Ines de Ramon met

articles.title: Taylor Swift’s former classmate defends Vanity Fair’s report and insists she is ‘equally as talented’
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift’s former classmate is speaking out after Vanity Fair’s controversial profile on the pop superstar.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift’s former classmate is speaking out after Vanity Fair’s controversial profile on the pop superstar.
articles.body:
On Monday, Vanity Fair journalist May Jeong published an extensive profile of Taylor Swift based on interviews with more than 100 sources. The piece offers a highly critical look at the pop star, describing her as a controlling and “punitive” figure while questioning much of the public image she has carefully constructed throughout her career.

Over the years, Swift has meticulously shaped her own narrative. In various interviews, she has described feeling like an outsider during her childhood, claiming that her friends sidelined her when she was young. That story has also been reflected in her songs and the re-releases of her albums, where her romantic breakups, personal disputes, and professional conflicts are typically presented from her perspective.

This narrative strategy has accompanied the rise of one of the most successful artists of all time. Her Eras Tour became the highest-grossing tour in history, and in 2023 Swift officially reached billionaire status.

One day after the profile was published, Arielle Peppers , a former schoolmate of Taylor Swift and one of the people interviewed by Jeong, expanded on her comments in an interview with TMZ .

Peppers recalled that when both attended Wyomissing Area Junior/Senior High School , Swift owned three pairs of UGG boots —a luxury that, according to her, would have represented half a paycheck for her own mother.

“She had the brown one, the black one, the blue one,” she recalled.

While acknowledging the singer’s talent, Peppers also maintained that opportunity made the difference between them.

“She’s very talented. She always was talented. She just had the means to become famous and do so. I am equally as talented,” Peppers told TMZ.

When asked about the Vanity Fair article, Peppers said she considers the report “fair.”

“I think it was fair,” Peppers said. “The whole thing about it was never forget where you come from. You’re from Wyomissing, PA, not Nashville. So in that statement, we both had the same music teacher, Sharon Libin, and Ronnie Kramer. They both taught me and Taylor, and I will always give my credit where credit is due. And Sharon Libin definitely deserves her credit.”

Despite believing that circumstances prevented her from reaching the same level of success as Swift, Peppers insisted she holds no resentment.

“Life is not fair. You get the cards that you’re dealt with. And she got a really lucky hand, but I got a blessed hand. So, you know, I wish her nothing but success.”

According to Jeong, many people declined to speak publicly for the report. Others, however, agreed to share unfiltered opinions about the “Life of a Showgirl” artist. So far, Taylor Swift has declined to comment on the Vanity Fair investigation and has not publicly responded to the claims in the article.

articles.title: Who is Jennifer Barreto, the new Miss Universe Puerto Rico?
articles.standfirst: Jennifer Barreto made history at Miss Universe 2026, but her journey to the crown goes far beyond beauty.
articles.summary: Jennifer Barreto made history at Miss Universe 2026, but her journey to the crown goes far beyond beauty.
articles.body:
J ennifer Barreto is a Puerto Rican model, social worker, and beauty queen who represented Puerto Rico at Miss Universe 2026 , where she won the title. She stood out for her story of resilience, academic achievements, and commitment to serving communities.

Her journey extends far beyond the runway. Barreto successfully combined her participation in beauty pageants with a career focused on prevention, mental health, and supporting families in vulnerable situations. She also became one of the contestants who showed that motherhood and international competition can go hand in hand.

Before reaching Miss Universe, Jennifer Barreto gained professional experience in programs focused on preventing domestic violence, child abuse, and providing support to families, particularly within military communities in the United States.

Jennifer Barreto was born in Mayagüez, Puerto Rico , and grew up in Isabela. Throughout her academic journey, she also developed connections with municipalities such as San Sebastián and Aguadilla .

In June 2026 , she was crowned Miss Universe Puerto Rico , representing San Sebastián, earning the opportunity to represent the island at the 75th edition of Miss Universe, held in Puerto Rico.

Her profile stood out for combining beauty, professional preparation, and community service, with a strong focus on promoting mental health and social well-being.

How old is Jennifer Barreto?

Jennifer Barreto is 27 years old.

She was born on December 17, 1998, in Mayagüez, Puerto Rico.

What is Jennifer Barreto’s zodiac sign?

Jennifer Barreto is a Sagittarius.

Who is Jennifer Barreto’s husband?

Jennifer Barreto is married to Yan Carlos Barreto Calderón , a sergeant in the United States Army .

Who are Jennifer Barreto’s children?

Jennifer Barreto is the mother of a daughter named Penélope, who was born in 2019 .

Her role as a mother has been one of the most notable aspects of her story in the world of beauty pageants.

What did Jennifer Barreto study?

Jennifer Barreto holds a bachelor’s degree in Psychology and two master’s degrees: one in Psychology and another in Clinical Social Work .

She also has specialized training in trauma intervention, suicide prevention, child protection, domestic violence, community needs assessment, and the development of prevention strategies.

Where has Jennifer Barreto worked?

Jennifer Barreto began her professional career in 2021 at Fort Cavazos , Texas , where she worked for the U.S. Department of the Army through the Family Advocacy Program as an educator and crisis response specialist.

In that role, she provided support to military families dealing with domestic violence, child abuse, and other social challenges.

She later volunteered at the Carl R. Darnall Army Medical Center as a prevention specialist. There, she contributed to community needs assessments, risk factor analysis, and the creation of strategies aimed at strengthening family well-being.

With a combination of academic preparation, professional experience, and social commitment, Jennifer Barreto arrived at Miss Universe 2026 as one of Puerto Rico’s most accomplished representatives.

articles.title: The enormous fortune Hayden Panettiere leaves to her eleven-year-old daughter comes to light, but without a will
articles.standfirst: The actress died last August 16
articles.summary: The actress died last August 16
articles.body:
The death of Hayden Panettiere shocked the Hollywood industry. The actress, very popular thanks to her role in the series "Heroes" , among others, died last August 16 at the age of 36. Months after her death, the enormous fortune the artist left to her eleven-year-old daughter has come to light.

Kaya , as she is called, is the daughter of Hayden Panettiere and former Ukrainian boxer Wladimir Klitschko . According to Page Six, the actress left behind a fortune amounting to 6.2 million dollars , including personal assets and estate. Panettiere did not leave a written will, but the court ruling cited by this outlet has determined that she is the sole heir to her entire estate .

For his part, the actress’s former partner and Kaya’s father, Wladimir Klitschko , asked the courts to appoint him as the person responsible for his daughter’s estate: "It is urgent and essential." The court granted him temporary guardianship of the assets. The former Ukrainian boxer also claimed that federal agents may have entered Hayden Panettiere ’s home and taken property.

Wladimir Klitschko's emotional message to Hayden Panettiere

Despite their separation, Wladimir Klitschko and Hayden Panettiere maintained a good relationship . " The announcement of Hayden's tragic death deeply saddens me. She left this world far too soon. Hayden was, although she was no longer my partner, an important part of my life and the mother of our daughter, Kaya. She built an incredible career thanks to immense talent, while also facing the darkest sides of a very demanding industry. Nothing will erase the moments we shared or the place she held in our lives. To our daughter Kaya, I will always speak of her mother with respect and make sure she remembers the person she was ," the Ukrainian stated on social media in a message published after the artist's death.

articles.title: Jean-Jacques Rousseau, philosopher: "Walking on foot is the best way to travel"
articles.standfirst: Rousseau's critique of private property reveals the root of social inequality, a theme that resonates today as it questions justice and fairness in our societies.
articles.summary: Rousseau's critique of private property reveals the root of social inequality, a theme that resonates today as it questions justice and fairness in our societies.
articles.body:
The constant search for direction and meaning in life is a universal human struggle. Many feel trapped in routine, longing for happiness but unable to attain it. This desire for others' approval can lead to a paralyzing fear of making mistakes, generating loneliness and frustration, elements that shape our interpersonal relationships. Rousseau, in "The Confessions" , suggests that the act of walking reflects one of the most authentic means of exploring the world and oneself. This metaphor invites reflection on the importance of the personal journey toward self-understanding and genuine happiness.

The parallelism between walking and life resonates with those who face fear of the future and the inability to enjoy the present . With each step, the possibility of discovery emerges, not only of external landscapes, but of the inner essence as well. This struggle is the root of many deep human emotions, where direction and personal fulfillment become goals to be attained, highlighting the need to find an authentic path amid the confusion of the contemporary social environment.

Walking on foot is the best way to travel

The original goodness of man and the social contract in the work of Jean-Jacques Rousseau

Jean-Jacques Rousseau (1712-1778) was a Swiss polymath, philosopher, educator, and writer whose work left a significant impact on modern political and social thought . Born in Geneva, the context of his life was marked by the pursuit of freedom and truth, which was reflected in his criticism of social conventions and his exploration of human nature. Rousseau is known for his theories on the original goodness of man and the social contract, ideas that not only transformed philosophy, but also laid the foundations of modern democracy.

In his work, Rousseau argues that the human being is inherently good , but that society corrupts him, a perspective that contrasts with the thought of other philosophers such as Hobbes and Locke. This view challenges the inequalities forged by private property, which he considers the root of social conflicts. He also proposes that a legitimate government must be based on the general will of the people, which resonates with current democratic principles. Throughout his life, his ideas influenced movements such as the French Revolution and continue to be relevant in debates on social justice and progressive education.

articles.title: Inés Gómez Mont is free in the United States: Is she escaping justice in Mexico?
articles.standfirst: The Mexican TV host and actress had been detained since October 30 in Florida
articles.summary: The Mexican TV host and actress had been detained since October 30 in Florida
articles.body:
The case of the famous Mexican actress and host, Inés Gómez Mont , has taken a new turn regarding her fragile legal situation, as several media outlets have reported that the former TV Azteca collaborator has been released after her arrest in the United States following the payment of bail, which has allowed her to leave the prison where she had been detained since last October 30 by the Immigration and Customs Enforcement Service (ICE by its acronym in English ) of the United States in Florida.

It is worth remembering that this case regained media relevance just a few weeks ago; however, it is not something new, since the woman who became extremely famous for dressing as a bride and proposing to then- New England Patriots quarterback Tom Brady during the media day held before Super Bowl XLII , which they would end up losing to the New York Giants led by quarterback Eli Manning at what was then called University of Phoenix Stadium in Glendale, Arizona, has three arrest warrants in our country.

What is Inés Gómez Mont accused of in Mexico?

The famous woman, who was also married to businessman Javier Díaz Bravo from 2008 to 2013 and who for many years collaborated with Pati Chapoy on the flagship entertainment program called ‘ Ventaneando ’ on the television network owned by Ricardo Salinas Pliego , is accused of organized crime, money laundering, and tax evasion, all of this in connection with her partnership with her husband, the famous lawyer Víctor Manuel Álvarez Puga , ‘The King of Fake Invoices,’ with whom she allegedly laundered up to 3 billion pesos through multiple unprovided and simulated services using apocryphal invoices from shell companies.

All this scandal would have taken place between 2014 and 2016 under the administration of the then President of Mexico, Enrique Peña Nieto , whose Secretary of the Interior was Miguel Ángel Osorio Chong , both members of the Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) , which at the time caused serious damage to the public treasury and, after being uncovered, resulted in the couple fleeing to South Florida .

Nationality : Mexican and Spanish.

Academic background : She studied for a bachelor's degree in Communication Sciences at Universidad Iberoamericana.

Occupation : Television host, reporter, actress, and writer.

Years active on television : 1997 to 2019.

What was supposed to be a triumphant homecoming celebration for Puerto Rico at the 75th Miss Universe competition quickly spiraled into an online firestorm on Tuesday night, November 24.

Inside the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, outgoing titleholder Fátima Bosch of Mexico placed the crown on 27-year-old Jennifer Barreto , securing the island’s sixth overall victory ahead of first runner-up Melissa Núñez of the Dominican Republic, Venezuela’s Clara Vegas , the Philippines’ Bea Millan-Windorski , and New Zealand’s Georgia Waddington .

Within minutes of the telecast wrapping up, however, thousands of disillusioned pageant followers took to social media to challenge the outcome.

Comment sections across major Latin American and international outlets, including CNN en Español, which drew more than 1,300 replies, Listín Diario with over 500, and El Heraldo de México with more than 300, were quickly overrun with accusations of “fraud,” “theft,” and “shady dealing.”

Much of the sharpest pushback came from supporters of Núñez and the Dominican Republic, who argued that the judging panel overlooked stronger finalists.

Critics questioning the verdict have centered their complaints on three main arguments:

- Home-turf advantage: Skeptics pointed out that hosting the Diamond Jubilee gala in San Juan naturally tilted momentum in Puerto Rico’s favor, drawing parallels to 2001, when Denise Quiñones captured the Miss Universe title on home soil in Bayamón.

- Early exits for pre-show frontrunners: Several delegates widely favored by pageant analysts heading into Tuesday’s finale were eliminated before the final five, fueling online frustration over how the field of 116 contestants was narrowed down.

- The Q&A round and interpreter debate: Viewers scrutinized Barreto’s performance during the decisive question-and-answer segments, claiming that relying on a Spanish-English interpreter during the Top 5 round gave her extra time to formulate her thoughts before she later answered in English. When asked about artificial intelligence, Barreto stated: “Artificial intelligence is here to stay. I believe the most important thing is to act responsibly. If technology puts our values at risk, then they were never solid values to begin with.”

Who is Jennifer Barreto, and why Puerto Rico is celebrating a historic victory

Despite the intensity of the backlash, which even saw some online commenters speculate about her professional ties to the U.S. government, neither pageant organizers nor competing national directors have filed any formal complaint, and no evidence of voting irregularities or judge tampering has surfaced.

Across Puerto Rico, outlets such as Wapa TV struck a celebratory tone, applauding Barreto for ending a 20-year title drought stretching back to Zuleyka Rivera’s win in 2006.

Beyond the controversy, Barreto’s path to the crown stands out as one of the most unconventional in pageant history.

Born Jennifer Abreu Mora , the San Sebastián native made history Tuesday night as the first married woman and mother to win Miss Universe in the organization’s 75-year existence, following rule changes that opened the competition to wives and parents.

Remarkably, she had never competed in a beauty pageant or walked a runway prior to 2026, embarking on a year-long preparation regimen in which she lost nearly 70 pounds before capturing the national title in June.

Offstage, Barreto is married to a U.S. Army sergeant, raises a 7-year-old daughter, holds a bachelor’s degree in research psychology alongside two master’s degrees in Psychology and Clinical Social Work, and works as a civilian prevention specialist for the U.S. Department of Defense.

Throughout her reign, she will wear “The Radiance of an Eternal Legacy,” an 18-karat white gold crown encrusted with 3,150 diamonds, as she sets out to prove to skeptics that her historic victory was earned on merit.

articles.title: How much money did Puerto Rican Jennifer Barreto earn after being crowned the new Miss Universe 2026?
articles.standfirst: It was a historic Diamond Jubilee victory in San Juan
articles.summary: It was a historic Diamond Jubilee victory in San Juan
articles.body:
Inside a packed José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan on Tuesday night, November 24, more than 18,000 spectators, and millions of viewers worldwide, watched Puerto Rico’s Jennifer Barreto capture the crown at the 75th edition of Miss Universe .

After advancing through swimsuit, evening gown, and interview rounds against 115 fellow delegates, the 27-year-old psychologist and clinical social worker edged out first runner-up Melissa Núñez of the Dominican Republic and second runner-up Clara Vegas Goetz of Venezuela to succeed outgoing Mexican queen Fátima Bosch.

Beyond making history as the first married woman and mother to win in the pageant’s 75-year run, Barreto stepped into one of entertainment’s most lucrative ambassadorial packages.

Although the Miss Universe Organization keeps its exact contractual terms private, international outlets, including Tropicana FM, ¡HOLA!, and Gulf News, report that the newly crowned winner receives an upfront cash prize of $250,000 (equivalent to more than 900 million Colombian pesos).

That initial payout is only the beginning. Throughout her 12-month reign, Barreto is also slated to earn a $50,000 monthly allowance, totaling $600,000 over the year, designated to fund her official duties, charitable projects, and daily work as an international goodwill ambassador.

Combined, the base prize money and monthly stipend bring Barreto’s projected annual compensation to roughly $850,000, before accounting for lucrative third-party commercial deals.

As a reigning titleholder, she gains immediate access to high-paying advertising campaigns, luxury brand sponsorships, and paid appearances at major fashion and red-carpet events worldwide, opportunities that frequently push a Miss Universe winner’s total earnings into seven-figure territory before she passes on the sash.

Inside the New York City residence, travel perks, and 3,150-diamond crown

The financial rewards of the Miss Universe title are designed to support a demanding global schedule, allowing the reigning queen to focus on her platform without covering living or operational overhead.

As part of her winner’s package, Barreto receives rent-free accommodations for one year in an apartment located in an exclusive neighborhood of New York City, the longtime headquarters of the Miss Universe Organization.

During her residency, the organization covers routine household expenses, including utilities, groceries, and housekeeping services.

Her perks extend well beyond housing. Whenever Barreto travels abroad to represent sponsors, media partners, or charitable causes, the organization finances her flights, upscale hotel stays, ground transportation, and security.

She is also backed by an in-house team of personal stylists, image consultants, and hair and makeup artists, alongside nutrition counseling and psychological support to help her navigate a year in the global spotlight.

Of course, the most iconic symbol of her victory is the newly unveiled 75th-anniversary crown itself: “The Radiance of an Eternal Legacy.” Designed by Venezuelan jeweler George Wittels and crafted in Paris by fine-jewelry house Maison d’OR, the bespoke piece is forged from 18-karat white gold and encrusted with 3,150 diamonds.

While the crown remains the property of the organization and will pass to her successor next year, the financial rewards and global visibility Barreto secured in San Juan ensure her historic triumph will pay dividends long after her reign ends.

articles.title: Who is Yan Carlos Barreto, husband of the new Miss Universe 2026 Jennifer Barreto and a sergeant in the United States Army?
articles.standfirst: She is a historic winner
articles.summary: She is a historic winner
articles.body:
When 27-year-old Jennifer Barreto claimed the Miss Universe 2026 crown on Tuesday, November 24, at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, she did more than secure Puerto Rico’s sixth international title and succeed outgoing queen Fátima Bosch of Mexico.

She also shattered a 75-year barrier by becoming the first married woman and mother to win the global competition, sparking immediate curiosity about the family standing beside her, especially her husband, Yan Carlos Barreto Calderón .

Originally from Isabela, a coastal municipality in northwestern Puerto Rico where Jennifer was also raised after being born Jennifer Abreu Mora in Mayagüez, Yan Carlos, sometimes referred to as Jean Carlos Barreto in local Puerto Rican media, serves as a sergeant in the United States Army.

Within the armed forces, he has worked in a military logistics capacity connected to the Army’s storied 101st Airborne Division.

Unlike his wife, whose victory over 115 delegates thrust her onto the global entertainment stage overnight, Yan Carlos keeps a distinctly low public profile, steering clear of social media fanfare and rarely stepping in front of cameras outside of major pageant milestones.

While the couple has chosen to keep their exact wedding date and the story of how they first met private, both have emphasized that mutual trust and careful planning made Jennifer’s unprecedented pageant run possible.

Watching from the San Juan arena as his wife edged out first runner-up Melissa Núñez of the Dominican Republic, Yan Carlos struggled to hold back emotion afterward, telling reporters the atmosphere was extraordinary and admitting he was nearly speechless while noting that pursuing the crown had been a joint family decision from day one.

How military service, parenthood, and family teamwork shaped Jennifer Barreto’s path to the crown

Long before Jennifer adopted her married surname on the international runway, the couple’s lives were already deeply intertwined through their shared dedication to the U.S. military community.

Armed with a bachelor’s degree in research psychology alongside two master’s degrees in psychology and clinical social work, Jennifer began working as a civilian employee for the U.S. Department of the Army at Fort Hood, Texas, in 2021.

In her role as a prevention specialist, as well as through volunteer work at the Carl R. Darnall Army Medical Center, she has focused on strengthening military families, supporting survivors of domestic violence and child abuse, and designing community wellness programs.

At the center of their household is their daughter, Penélope , whom they welcomed in 2019. Now 7 years old, Penélope has been a constant presence throughout her mother’s rapid rise from first-time pageant entrant to international titleholder.

Both Yan Carlos and Penélope joined Jennifer onstage in emotional celebration when she won Miss Universe Puerto Rico on June 25, 2026, and Penélope charmed pageant fans again during the Miss Universe national costume show by wearing a custom green dress by Puerto Rican designer Lissa Porrata that echoed her mother’s moriviví-inspired ensemble.

Enabled by the Miss Universe Organization’s landmark 2023 eligibility reform welcoming wives and mothers, Jennifer has repeatedly stressed that parenthood should never force women to shelve their academic or career aspirations.

As she begins a year-long international reign based in New York City, Yan Carlos and Penélope remain the quiet foundation behind one of pageantry’s most historic triumphs.
